lessons: Add a new base-red test to tests/test_drain_reentry.py: make Verification red on main and on the branch, then drain one implement+verdict script. Assert exit 0, one implement request, no `retry` in the journal, and one box failure_report (outcome base_red) naming the command.

Do not edit the bodies of the existing tests in tests/test_drain_reentry.py, including test_a_reoffer_after_a_red_check_renders_the_failing_checks and test_a_stale_review_md_never_feeds_a_later_check_failure. Run `git diff` on that file before finishing: the only changes should be additions.
If the existing re-entry tests go base-red under attribution, keep each command green at the merge base by changing the shared repo/author/drain helper or fixture, not the test bodies.

If a shared helper change still cannot keep the existing tests unchanged and green, stop and record it in the run record as a ticket conflict (AC5 vs attribution) rather than editing the tests silently.

Before finishing, check every acceptance criterion against the diff and name the test that proves each one. AC5 needs both a NEW test and the existing tests left UNCHANGED, and a green suite alone does not show either.
